login.title: Login to your account
login.description: Enter your email below to login to your account
login.signUp: Do not have an account? <link>Sign up</link>

oidcLogin.title: Sign in to continue
oidcLogin.description: {application} is asking you to sign in

signUp.title: Join {organization}
signUp.description: Create an account to get access. We will send you a confirmation email.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new one.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.description: If an account exists for {email}, a link to choose a new password is on its way.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: This link works once. Anywhere you are still signed in will be signed out.

done.title: Password changed
done.description: Every other session was signed out. Log in with your new password.
done.descriptionInvitation: Every other session was signed out. Sign in with your new password to accept the invitation.

confirm.title: Confirm your email address
confirm.description: One more step and your account is ready to use.

confirmChange.title: Confirm your new email address
confirmChange.description: Once you confirm, you sign in with {to} instead of {from}.

confirmed.title: Address confirmed
confirmed.description: Your account is ready. Continue to {organization}.

inbox.title: Check your inbox
inbox.description: We sent you a confirmation link. Follow it to finish setting up your account.
inbox.descriptionWithEmail: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Until you follow it, this account cannot be used.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication

totp.label: Authentication code
totp.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

backupCode.label: Backup code
backupCode.description: Enter one of the backup codes you saved. Each one works only once.

twoFactor.trustDevice: Trust this device for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
twoFactor.trustDeviceDescription: Only on a device nobody else uses.

validation.passwordTooShort: Use at least {min, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
validation.tooLong: Use at most {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
validation.totpInvalid: Enter the 6-digit code from your app
validation.backupCodeRequired: Enter one of your backup codes
validation.backupCodeInvalid: That is not a backup code

errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.tooManySignInAttemptsLater: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again later.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.tooManyRequestsLater: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.tooManyEmails: Too many requests. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.tooManyCodes: Too many incorrect codes. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.accountDisabled: This account is disabled. Contact your administrator.
errors.notMember: You are not a member of this organization
errors.incomplete: Your sign-in could not be completed
errors.passkeyFailed: That passkey could not be used
errors.passkeySignInFailed: That passkey could not be used to sign in
errors.emailNotSent: That email could not be sent
errors.confirmationExpired: This confirmation link has expired. Send yourself a new one.
errors.resetLinkInvalid: This reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
errors.signUpsClosed: Your account was created, but this organization no longer accepts sign-ups.
errors.accountNotCreated: That account could not be created
errors.signInExpired: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
errors.totpInvalid: That code is not valid. Check your app and try again.
errors.backupCodeInvalid: That backup code is not valid or has already been used.
